exposure: Type of gynecological procedure (hysteroscopy, LLETZ conisation, TVT, laparoscopy, hysterectomy, caesarean section)
outcome: Behavioral recommendations for postoperative care (duration of sick leave, follow-up, bathing, tampon use, sexual activity, sports, lifting restrictions)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 54 gynecologists (46% response rate) and 49 clinics (62% response rate) in Austria who responded to questionnaires about postoperative care recommendations.
finding: The study found significant heterogeneity in postoperative advice across Austria, with clinics tending to recommend more restrictive measures than specialists for certain procedures (LLETZ, TVT, laparoscopy), while advice aligned for others (hysterectomy, caesarean section).
mod_finding: For caesarean section, both specialists and clinics advised 4-6 weeks of recovery with restrictions on weight lifting, sexual activity, and sports, indicating alignment in recommendations between these groups for this mode of birth.
